title: Receivables, Payables & Cash
description: AR/AP ageing, a collections worklist and a cash-flow view for receivables, payables and cash.
notes: AR/AP outstanding is read from the Payment Ledger (delinked=0) rather than reconstructed from GL, which is far cheaper on large sites. Like the Accounts Receivable and Payable reports, it nets unallocated payments and journal entries against invoices. Cash flow is read from GL entries on Bank and Cash accounts, leaving out opening entries and transfers between them. Snapshot figures are as-of-today in each company's base currency, so a reading that spans companies with different currencies prints bare. Reads Company for each company's currency and Account for bank and cash accounts, so a reader needs those tables too; the date filter drives the cash-flow trends.
